_comment: C0-17 正文英译 · moyin（2026-10-26）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」4 行带 .md 链接（minimax-audio/fish-audio/elevenlabs/hailuo-video），related 写 4 条（frontmatter related 是 [minimax-audio, fish-audio, hailuo-video]，键按正文链接行对齐=4——elevenlabs 行在正文但不在 frontmatter）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 带「实测建议」三条段。B 类候选：算法备案登记名「出门问问语音合成类算法」在 permissions 轴英文句内按 vidu/moyin 同口径原样保留（登记名不可译）。

axes.model_access: Mobvoi's self-developed speech-synthesis line (the official algorithm filing "出门问问语音合成类算法" covers Moyin Workshop — CAC public-registry narrative); multi-voice/multi-emotion dubbing lines inside the platform; users pick voices, not bare models.
axes.runtime: Web (moyin.com) as the main entry; dubbing on the vendor's cloud. No official offline-weights line seen.
axes.local_files: Projects and finished outputs stored on the account-side cloud (projects can be revisited and edited); downloads count as local. No officially stated local data surface seen.
axes.background: Editing + synthesis is an interactive form (edit text, preview in real time, re-listen line by line); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" concept.
axes.tools: Text-to-speech dubbing (multi-voice/emotion/speed control), **voice cloning** (official product surface), video-dubbing workflows (subtitle alignment/multi-character dubbing lines, seen on the official site); an overseas line (Qimiaoyuan and other related-product narratives — outside this dossier's scope).
axes.context: Organized by project; cross-session memory not verified to an official statement. Voice assets are the "consistency" mechanism.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: pricing not collected); **the voice-cloning authorization line is a must-answer item** — the official agreement carries authorization framing (agreement page direct-fetched on record), details not verified item by item (inclusion criterion 3). Algorithm filing: 出门问问语音合成类算法 (its service surface includes Moyin Workshop) appears in the deep-synthesis algorithm filing list — the number follows the official query portal beian.cac.gov.cn (the batch list was relayed via a third-party mirror, the original attachment was not directly fetched); algorithm filing and service filing are two numbering systems.
axes.fit: Fits: Chinese dubbing workflows (audiobooks/short videos/courseware), cloning your own voice, domestic direct connection and Chinese-language support. Does not fit: cloning other people's voices (authorization red line), wanting open weights, English-first usage.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Actual strictness of the voice-cloning authorization verification flow**
- **Efficiency of the multi-character dubbing workflow** (vs ElevenLabs/studio-class tools)
- **Granularity and stability of emotion control**
unknowns:
- The generative-AI service filing number (not found — see the cn block)
- The training-use switch (not verified item by item)
- Tier boundaries of commercial licensing (agreement original not verified item by item)
- Cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
related: Both domestic TTS/cloning lines: MiniMax is API-strong, Moyin Workshop is dubbing-workflow-strong.
Also cloning-oriented: fish audio has a community voice ecosystem, Moyin Workshop an official voice library + workflows.
International contrast: ElevenLabs has a wider multilingual surface, Moyin Workshop finer Chinese dubbing workflows.
Downstream of dubbing: finished voiceovers are often stitched with AI video assets into final cuts — the two lines meet in short-video workflows (cross-linked after filing).
